sources.1: FAIL 25/32 who=0x70, config readback ok, STATUS read hit one SPI error

latest_run.unused_control: sid6 (tied-off channel on bus A) reads 0xFF, so a floating A_MISO reads high

observation: sid6 reading 0xFF on the same bus shows what an undriven bus looks like. The four dead sources read a steady 0x00, which is a gate that is enabled and driving low, so their /OE and their row-11 output are connected and the fault is on the gate input side: the module SDO wire or the module supply.
verdict: not a firmware, contract or collection-row fault; input-side wiring or module power on sid2/3/4/7, plus one transient transfer error on sid1
